description: Raise the fee cap of a renewal paused at needs_input because the NIPR fee is above its cap; the renewal then resumes. Only call this after the user explicitly approves the new cap in this conversation. approved_by_name and approved_by_email must name the person who approved it; ask them, never invent the approver. Never send SSNs, FEINs or other tax ids, dates of birth, passwords (NIPR or any other), card or bank numbers: the API refuses them, and you must not ask the user for them. Servicing: needs an API key.

fee_cap_cents.description: The new most authorized for this renewal, in cents
